method.pagesPerSite: Homepage or blog navigation plus one relevant article per site; rendered DOM metadata checked for five representative pages.

actionableGaps: Prefer five genuinely distinct user problems with direct answers, eligibility caveats, safe task flows, and official product references over a sixth generic best-browser ranking.
